title: Choose the visual world for Rehearse
question: The roll assigned The Rehearsal Room. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: The Rehearsal Room
options.lineage: theatre rehearsal rooms: black box floor, spike tape, cue lights, the director's notes session
options.thesis: Practice works like a rehearsal: run the answer, get notes, run it again as Take 2.
options.viewport: The question sits center stage on the floor; one big cue-light record button below; typing is one tap away.
options.risk: Theatre metaphor can turn twee if the copy leans on stage puns; labels stay plain.

raised.raise: Score changes on a retry swap instantly like a scoreboard, with the delta shown beside it.
Every attempt is numbered: Take 1, Take 2. The take number is the retry headline.
The current question lifts; everything else in the session dims out of the way.
Accent is confined to tape and state; all reading text stays achromatic.
Rubric scores sit in one tight tabular column with tabular numerals.

options.label: The Highlighted Transcript
options.lineage: study desk: highlighters and pencil margin notes on your own notes
options.thesis: Your spoken answer becomes the page, and feedback is highlighter on your own words.
options.viewport: A transcript sheet fills the screen; strengths and fixes are highlighted passages with margin notes.
options.risk: Familiar study-app territory; could read as homework rather than practice.

options.label: Seven-Segment Scoreboard
options.lineage: bedside clocks, gas-price totems, stadium scoreboards
options.thesis: Scores as lit segments that snap from 5.8 to 7.4 on a retry.
options.viewport: A large segment score board over a dark panel with the question below.
options.case: Holds clarity for scores and improvement; loses audience identification for the rest of the app.
options.risk: Reads as a novelty clock when the whole UI takes the grammar.

options.label: Catalog Sleeve
options.thesis: Every artifact numbered, names replaced by codes.
options.viewport: A catalog index of sessions by number.
options.case: Fuses poorly: coded labels fight plain-language clarity for a public audience.

options.label: Streaming Title Wall
options.thesis: Questions as tiles on horizontal rows.
options.case: Browsing rows suits choosing content, not answering one question at a time.
options.kept: Focus lifts the active item, the rest dims.

options.label: Industrial Quote Grammar
options.thesis: Everything labeled in straight quotes with hazard stripes.
options.case: Streetwear irony misreads the nervous job-seeker.

options.label: Iridescent Cloud Edge
options.thesis: Color only at hairline edges over achromatic text.
options.viewport: White field with thin spectral edges.
options.case: Beautiful but carries no interview meaning.

options.label: Datamatics Field
options.case: Hostile to anxious beginners; strobing is an accessibility risk.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A friendly gamified learning app: bright green, rounded cards, mascot energy.
canonCard.viewport: Big green start button, XP bar, streak counter.
